meta.title: Emulator Lab
meta.description: Boot Android AVDs and iOS Simulators from the sidebar, then estimate low-end phone FPS from a deterministic SoC model (INT8 TOPS, memory bandwidth and capacity, CPU/GPU scores, thermal budget).

emulator_detect.title: Detect emulators
emulator_detect.description: Report the emulator tooling on this machine plus the SoC and device profile ids this plugin offers.

emulator_launch.title: Launch emulator
emulator_launch.description: Boot an Android AVD or iOS Simulator for a low-end device profile, with RAM, heap and cores clamped to its SoC.

emulator_fps.title: Emulator FPS
emulator_fps.description: Estimate FPS deterministically from the SoC model, or measure the running emulator.
